title: Frequency-addressed state-dependent operator composition
summary: This pass narrows the FANMC / NotSoSimpleNeuron thread to a stronger executable condition: an address must select resident structure, local persistent state must change the operator encountered by the next event, and A→B must differ from B→A after fast state has settled away. v0 isolates the mechanism in reduced resonators. v1 re-embodies it in heterogeneous quasi-active cable branches without an explicit frequency-indexed slow memory. v2 then factorizes morphology from quasi-active kinetics. The strong four-way frequency address does not survive geometry alone: median-shared kinetics gives address rank 1.084 (1.760 after static branch-gain normalization), and sweeping each of the four original kinetic tuples uniformly across the 5/7/9/11 branches never raises raw address rank above 1.205 or gain-normalized rank above 1.878. By contrast, kinetic heterogeneity alone at equal branch length retains rank 4.000. Morphology still enriches the written operator family when kinetic diversity is present.

nodes.claim: Tests whether frequency can select resident modal/cable structure whose local persistent state rewrites the operator encountered by later packets, making addressed operator composition noncommutative after fast state has decayed.
nodes.survived: v0 passes a reduced-resonator gate with address effective rank 3.443, written-operator rank 3.078, commutator ratio 0.564 and paired order/jitter ratio 3.374x. v1 re-embodies the mechanism in four heterogeneous quasi-active cable branches with compartment-local slow state and no explicit frequency-slot memory: address rank 3.977, written-operator rank 2.581, local material-write rank 2.904, commutator ratio 0.0612 and paired order/jitter ratio 3.602x. v2 finds a sharper decomposition: equal-length branches retaining the original heterogeneous quasi-active kinetics preserve essentially four independent frequency addresses (rank 3.9999) and about 2.905 dimensions of material write; restoring morphology raises written-operator rank from 1.821 to 2.581.
nodes.killed: Order dependence alone is insufficient. A homogeneous-branch attacker retains a sizable order commutator while frequency-address rank collapses to 1.0. A global-scalar state attacker retains history but collapses the written operator family to about 1.12 effective dimensions. A frozen-operator attacker can accumulate slow material but produces zero operator rewrite and zero commutator. v2 kills the stronger 'cable geometry carries the spectral address' reading for the tested interface: geometry-only rank is 1.084 with median shared kinetics, and across all four original kinetic tuples imposed uniformly the maximum raw rank is 1.205 and the maximum gain-normalized rank is 1.878. The cable and active parameters remain synthetic and do not establish a biological dendrite mechanism or architecture advantage.

edges.why: The new repository takes FANMC's frequency-as-external-address result and asks the stricter question FANMC left open: whether the addressed event changes a resident operator so that later operator composition becomes order-dependent, rather than merely writing a persistent code.

NotSoSimpleNeuron established the receiver-side idea that resident active state changes what the next event encounters. This repository isolates that idea as an explicit noncommuting operator-composition gate and then re-embodies it in quasi-active cable branches.

InformationFlow made frequency and phase external coordinates for selecting interactions that write persistent routing state. The new experiment keeps frequency as an address but moves the consequence into a resident operator whose later composition is explicitly tested for order.

Operaattori supplies the structural-compiler view in which morphology generates an executable transport/nonlinear operator. The new repository studies the complementary runtime question: whether addressed local state can rewrite such an operator between events.

ArtificialCortex previously treated space, frequency and phase as coordinates of resident dynamical tissue. The new repository turns that broad architectural intuition into a much narrower controlled operator-composition experiment.

motifs.title: Addressing becomes computationally stronger when the first event rewrites the operator seen by the second
motifs.description: Frequency filtering, persistent memory and order dependence are each weaker than the combined object. The surviving condition is: different addresses excite different resident structure; the resulting local state causally changes the later operator; and compositions do not commute after fast transients have vanished. v2 sharpens what carries those clauses in the synthetic cable: quasi-active kinetic diversity carries the strong spectral address, while morphology enriches the dimensionality of the operator family written through that address. Geometry alone can remain path-dependent without becoming a useful multi-address system. This links FANMC's external stimulation language to NotSoSimpleNeuron's state-conditioned receiver, InformationFlow's spectral addressing, and Operaattori's substrate-generated operators.
